    Read an emss Excel workbook

    ess_read_excel.Rd

    Reads the five-sheet emss workbook (Setup, Panelists, Ratings, ItemMetaData, ExamineeMetaData) by sheet name, falling back to sheet position when a name is not found, and returns [ess_data()].

    Usage

    ess_read_excel(
  path,
  sheets = NULL,
  levels = NULL,
  sd = NULL,
  ec = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  quiet = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    path

    Path to the `.xlsx` file.

    sheets

    Optional sheet names, a named character vector with any of `setup`, `ratings`, `items`, `examinees`.

    levels

    Level labels from lowest to highest. A character vector applies to every grade; a named list gives labels per grade, for example `list(R1 = c("E", "M", "L"), R2 = c("B", "P", "A"))`. Overrides the setup table.

    sd, ec

    Scaling SD and essential-consistency threshold. A single number applies to every grade; a named vector gives values per grade. Override the setup table. Defaults are SD = 1 and EC = 0.

    columns

    Optional column mapping for tables whose column names differ from the defaults. A named list per table, each a named list or vector of input column names or positions, for example `list(ratings = list(item_id = "ItemID", level = 8))`. The standard names are: ratings `grade`, `round`, `table`, `panelist`, `item_id`, `level`; items `grade`, `item_id`, `domain`, `order`; setup `grade`, `levels`, `sd`, `ec`; examinees `grade`, `score`, `freq`.

    quiet

    If `FALSE`, report the column mapping that was used.

    Value

    An object of class `"ess_data"`.
